strategy.name: qqq_two_sma_recovery_probation_with_single_forced_rebuy
strategy.description: QQQ 初始空仓，以较短的卖出 SMA 负责下跌时快速退出，以较长的买入 SMA 负责熊市后的恢复入场。普通买入必须由完成收盘确认从长均线下方向上穿越，并在下一交易日 Open 成交；任何新买入先进入试探持仓。普通买入若在站上短均线前完成收盘重新落到长均线下方，则下一 Open 失败退出。短均线卖出后的 3% 强制买回每个熊市阶段最多一次；其试探持仓若在完成普通长均线上穿前收盘跌回原短均线卖出计成本成交价下方，则下一 Open 失败退出。试探持仓完成收盘站上短均线后升级为确认多头，之后按盘前可知的动态短均线向下穿越快速卖出并开启新的熊市阶段。
strategy.buy_rule: 空仓时，普通买入要求 prior_close <= prior_buy_sma 且 current_close > current_buy_sma；该收盘信号在下一交易日 Open 全仓买入。若最近一次确认多头由 sell-SMA 向下穿越卖出后，本熊市阶段尚未使用 c，则同时保留一次 last_confirmed_sell_effective_fill×1.03 的盘中强制买回线；没有已确认普通买入信号时，次日 Open 已越过该线按 Open 买入，否则 High 触线时按理论线买入。普通收盘信号优先于同日可执行的 c 计划。失败退出不得生成或刷新 c 锚。
strategy.sell_rule: 每次买入先进入试探持仓。普通长均线买入的试探持仓若完成 Close < current_buy_sma，则生成普通恢复失败信号并在下一 Open 清仓。c 买回的试探持仓若在完成普通长均线上穿之前 Close < 原确认多头 sell-SMA 卖出的计成本成交价，则生成强制买回失败信号并在下一 Open 清仓；若其间完成普通长均线上穿，则改用长均线作为失败边界。任何试探持仓若先完成 Close >= current_sell_sma，则升级为确认多头。确认多头每天盘前以完成历史解出次日动态 sell-SMA 交叉价；Open 已在其下方按 Open 卖出，否则 Low 向下触线时按理论线卖出。失败退出优先于同一收盘的状态升级，每日最多一笔成交。
strategy.signal_time: 普通长均线买入、试探失败和试探转为确认多头均只在常规交易日 Close 完成后确认；确认多头的下一日短均线卖出线和未使用的 c 买回线在开盘前只用已完成收盘、均线与既有账户成交价冻结。
strategy.execution_time: 所有完成 Close 才确认的普通买入和试探失败信号最早在下一常规交易日 Open 成交。盘前冻结的 sell-SMA 与 c 触发线若 Open 已越线则按 Open，否则按调整后日线 Low/High 首次可判定触线的理论价成交；随后施加单边 5 bps 不利成本。每日最多一笔，不利用当日收盘结果追溯获得更早价格。
strategy.positioning: long-only；2000-12-18 以 100,000 美元现金空仓开始；每次买入投入全部现金、每次卖出清空全部份额；允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.price_basis: approved split-and-dividend-adjusted QQQ OHLC; an internally consistent total-return approximation, not an exact raw-price corporate-action account replay

plain_language.summary: 用短均线尽快避开下跌，再用长均线寻找恢复，并把尚未站稳的买入当作可撤回的试探。
plain_language.buy: 空仓后，只有收盘真正从长均线下方回到上方，才在下一交易日开盘买入；短均线卖出后另保留一次上涨3%的纠错买回机会。
plain_language.sell: 新买入在站上短均线前若重新跌破自己的失败边界就退出；站上短均线后，下一次盘中向下穿过短均线时正常卖出。
plain_language.execution: 收盘确认的买入和失败退出都在下一交易日开盘成交；预先算好的短均线卖出和3%纠错线可在次日跳空或盘中触线成交，每天最多一笔。
plain_language.position: 每次买入使用全部现金，每次卖出全部清仓，允许小数股，不借钱，空仓现金不计利息。

parameters.warmup_policy: Use approved QQQ history from 1999-03-10. All cases start flat on 2000-12-18, the first common session with completed SMA450 inputs; signals before the common start are ignored.
parameters.ordinary_entry_timing: completed close crossing above buy SMA, next-session Open fill
parameters.confirmed_exit_timing: pre-open dynamic sell-SMA line, next-session Open gap or intraday Low touch
parameters.ordinary_probation_failure: completed close below current buy SMA before confirmation, next-session Open exit
parameters.forced_probation_failure: completed close below original confirmed sell effective fill before ordinary buy-SMA recovery or confirmation, next-session Open exit
parameters.confirmation_rule: a probation position becomes confirmed when a completed Close is at or above the current sell SMA
parameters.same_close_priority: probation failure before confirmation or forced-to-ordinary transition
parameters.subperiod_state_policy: Run one continuous strategy path. At each fixed subperiod boundary inherit cash, position, probation state, bear-episode anchor and c-use state; rebase equity only for subperiod metrics.

identifiability_gate.purpose: Require both SMA roles and the new failed-recovery mechanism to occur often enough before interpreting a parameter pair.

surface_selection.primary_metric: minimum CAGR across the three fixed inherited-state subperiods
surface_selection.boundary_policy: A component touching 80 or 450 is reported but cannot nominate a stable period region.
surface_selection.representative_rule: Within the largest eligible top-decile component require a complete 3x3 neighborhood and maximize local median primary metric minus 0.5 times local standard deviation; break ties by full-history Sharpe, full-history CAGR, distance to component centroid, then lower turnover.

parent_control.comparison: Compare all matching 38x38 cells and the old/new 310/190 paths without modifying the validated parent run.

multiple_testing.pbo_metric: Annualized daily Sharpe from the selected six-block training half and its complement across all 1,444 eligible cases.
multiple_testing.trial_count_policy: Report correlation-adjusted effective trials and the conservative full 1,444-case count; apply DSR only after the surface representative is frozen.

formal_reconciliation.surface_representative: Reconcile the deterministic local-stability representative even when a structural or statistical gate fails.
formal_reconciliation.objective_champions: Deduplicated full-history CAGR, Sharpe and maximum-drawdown champions.
formal_reconciliation.requirement: Every case must match two independently structured compiled ledgers within 1e-9; all formal candidates must match PyBroker and the Python reference ledger in dates, sides, shares, fills, cash and equity within 1e-6.

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: Invest the same 100,000 USD at the 2000-12-18 regular-session Open with 5 bps adverse entry cost and hold QQQ through 2015-12-31.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse interactive_research_v5 unchanged and supply experiment-specific state-path, old/new surface, PBO/DSR and formal-ledger figures through the shared renderer.

research.hypothesis: The old long-buy/short-sell period surface may partly benefit from remaining long after an unconfirmed rebound. Treating every new entry as probationary, exiting failed recoveries and limiting c to one attempt per bear episode should reduce left-side bear-market exposure while retaining a connected buy/sell-period plateau rather than merely shifting losses into excessive turnover.
research.primary_metric: Minimum inherited-state CAGR across the same three frozen 2000-2015 subperiods, subject to ordinary-buy, confirmed-sell, probation-failure and two-dimensional plateau gates.
research.selection_rule: Apply parameters.surface_selection to the complete 38x38 surface. Report the inherited 310/190 pair, the deterministic stable representative, full-history CAGR/Sharpe/drawdown champions, and per-cell deltas versus the validated parent c3/d-off surface. No single historical winner may override subperiod, event-count, boundary, PBO or DSR gates.
research.validation_plan: Save all 1,444 case metrics, inherited-state subperiods, signal/state counts, parent deltas, surface geometry, PBO splits and DSR inputs. Cross-check every case through two compiled ledgers; reconcile predeclared anchors, the surface representative and objective champions through PyBroker and an independent Python ledger; require approved-data hash, tests, catalog rebuild, workspace audit, interactive Chrome and PDF gates.
research.promotion_criteria: No direct promotion from this semantic redevelopment on reused 2000-2015 data. A region may be retained for future walk-forward research only if it is identifiable, non-boundary, connected, has positive primary metric, PBO<=20%, effective-trials DSR>=95%, and improves drawdown or worst-subperiod behavior versus the matching parent region without a disproportionate turnover increase.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject a unique parameter claim if no qualifying two-dimensional plateau exists, the dominant region touches a search boundary, either SMA role or the probation mechanism is underidentified, improvement comes only from an isolated cell or a single subperiod, PBO exceeds20%, DSR is below95%, turnover rises without material risk improvement, or any timing, accounting, hash, test, catalog, report or browser gate fails. The previously viewed 2016-2026 path is diagnostic and cannot be reused as pristine locked evidence for this new semantic.
